version_distinction.v2: 642 task Harbor split; public repository contains reference/gold patches and verifier assets; README describes how to generate new model.patch artifacts by running agents and re-grade them.
version_distinction.v1: Original 731-task release, separately identified by README as HF config v1 / tag v1.0 and the legacy pipeline. Do not transfer v1 attempts/outcomes to V2.

anonymous_s3.interpretation: Anonymous access succeeds for historical run material, but bucket listing exposes no V2-designated export. The root README labels the available v1 pipeline separately; S3 keys themselves do not prove dataset version. No V2 attempts may be inferred from this listing.

positive_legacy_artifact_example_not_for.outcome: Verifier output reports a FAILED before-all test hook. This is explicit failed verifier evidence for this legacy attempt, not V2 evidence or proof of authoritative V2 re-grading.

swe_bench_pro.closure: V2 task/gold assets are public, but no V2 model patch plus explicit task outcome export was located in pinned GitHub or the anonymous S3 listing. V1/legacy patch and failure artifacts are accessible, but version mismatch prohibits reuse as V2. No importer should be implemented from this evidence.

gold_patch_example.classification: Gold/reference patch only; not a model attempt.

license_and_reuse.third_party_base_repository_rights: Not cleared by the benchmark license; evaluate relevant source-project license separately.
license_and_reuse.model_patch_and_attempt_rights: No model artifacts were found; redistribution rights for hypothetical outputs are unverified.
license_and_reuse.leaderboard_aggregates: Not per-task attempt artifacts; cannot reconstruct model patches or failures.

anonymous_s3.result: No SWE-Atlas Refactoring anonymous S3 artifact endpoint was identified in the pinned public repository sources.

swe_atlas_refactoring.closure: Public RF task configs and gold patches are available; public model final patches and explicit per-task model outcomes/failures are not present in the inspected pinned GitHub tree. No historical run can be imported. Keep RF gold patches distinct from model outputs.

limitations: Absence from the inspected public GitHub tree and anonymous S3 prefix listing does not prove that private or separately hosted exports do not exist.
No source-project/license audit was performed for all 11 Pro repositories or all 70 Atlas RF projects.
No patches were applied, target code was executed, or benchmark tests/evaluators were run.
